comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
In honor of Atlantis' brief return...

This title is (temporarily) awarded to those who have explored the Labyrinth endless dungeon in one run. That is, you start a dungeon run floor 1 and keep going without exiting the dungeon, or being KO'd in battle; the game tracks server-wide dungeon exploration progress and the top three player/player fleets (which can be checked at any Adventure Mediator under Labyrinth Rankings --> Most Sections Ranking) who have gone the most floors in a single run will receive this title for use.

Note that the top three rankings are reset every two weeks beginning from the start of the month; the standings themselves can be reset whenever a player/player fleet surpasses an existing record (100 floors in one run will beat a 50 floor run, but 101 floors will beat 100, and so on). The effect of the title isn't altogether clear, but a Japanese blogger seems to think it raises the occurrence of Minotaur boss floors.

Source: apple9999.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-366.html

Whether or not that's really the case, or if the title also works in the Temple of Poseidon endless dungeon found in Atlantis to raise the likelihood of encountering those statue guys guarding orichalcum boxes, will be up to Maris players to determine for themselves. Cheers.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
For those in the top three Labyrinth rankings, custom titles can be set for as long as they are in the top 3 list. They are:

1st Selection: Legendary, Imaginary, Wandering, Murky, Shady
2nd Selection: Explorer, Supervisor, Monster, Evil Spirit, Mole

They can be mixed and matched however you like, and once set appear over your character name in green text (as most custom titles tend to appear). The custom titles you choose also remain even after you've lost your place in the top 3 list (but you'd have to make top 3 again to change them to any of the above listed options). The effect is purely cosmetic so far as I can tell and has no apparent effect on anything else; don't know if they blend with other custom titles or not. Cheers.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
According to GMs regarding this title's function: "The special rooms in the dungeons can occur between regular floors and you will get a chance to enter them if you are lucky. You can also choose to ignore them and continue on your path downward into the dungeon. Up to this point in the game practically all of the dungeons have a chance of spawning a secret room and the above title will increase the chance of these rooms appearing making it very useful for dungeon crawling. We hope that answers your question."

Doesn't sound like it necessarily influences the appearance rate of endless dungeon bosses, unless the black-aura super versions appear in those optional secret passages. Cheers.
